newsitem.title: USA: Favorable weather continues for Brazil coffee - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Favorable weather continues for Brazil coffee - WSC.

text.p: Generally favorable conditions continue for Brazil's coffee trees and maturing crop with cool temperatures but no damaging cold expected this week, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Thursday.
No damaging cold is indicated as there are no major cold air masses forecast to build out of Argentina, WSC said.

Conditions as of 0730 EDT (1130 GMT) showed scattered showers of 0.20 to 0.60 inch in the Brazilian coffee belt with temperatures near to below normal and lows on Thursday morning mostly in the 50s F (10-15 C).
Somewhat cooler than normal conditions are expected in the coffee belt through Sunday, with low temperatures that could fall in the 40s F to low 50s F (5-12 C).
Conditions will be milder Monday to Wednesday. Fair to partly cloudy skies are expected during the next 5-7 days.
